title: Consultant - Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - SAP FICO/SD with DRC E-Invoicing & E-Reporting - Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Tax Consultant II**
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - SAP FICO/SD with DRC E-Invoicing & E-Reporting**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support clients as they modernize and improve their tax operations. This role sits within Tax Transformation Consulting and focuses on SAP FICO/SD and SAP DRC-enabled e-invoicing and e-reporting initiatives. You will help translate tax and business requirements into technology-enabled solutions that improve compliance, reporting, and operational efficiency while working across tax, process, and technology teams.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Tax Consultant II on the Tax Transformation Consulting team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Supporting the delivery of tax technology and tax transformation projects for clients across industries
* Gathering, documenting, and analyzing business, process, and system requirements for tax-related initiatives
* Assisting with configuration, testing, validation, and implementation activities for tax technology solutions
* Preparing data analyses, reconciliations, and reporting outputs to support project objectives and client needs
* Collaborating with tax, technology, and client stakeholders to identify process improvement opportunities

**The team**
Tax Transformation Consulting helps clients respond to increased regulatory requirements and greater scrutiny by building tax functions that are strategic, agile, and focused on business value. The practice supports organizations in moving from their current state to the next generation of tax operations through process improvement, technology enablement, and operating model transformation.
  
  
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting professionals work across tax, technology, organizational change, and co-sourcing disciplines to help connect global business strategies with practical tax function solutions. The team brings together specialized experience to help clients improve efficiency, manage risk, and enhance the performance of their tax departments.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Shift Timings: 10 AM to 7 PM or 11 AM to 8 PM**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or Economics
* 2+ years of experience in tax technology, tax operations, tax transformation, or tax process support
* Experience with enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics
* Experience in configuring or oversee configuration of SAP DRC and eDocument Framework components, including electronic document types, statutory reporting definitions, output determination, and compliance monitoring. Experience of working with SAP Integration Suite, SAP BTP, PI/PO, or related middleware to connect SAP environments with tax authority platforms, e-invoicing networks, and external compliance providers. Support mapping of ERP data to required reporting formats such as XML, JSON, UBL, or jurisdiction-specific structures, and help resolve message, validation, and transmission issues.
* Experience with data, reporting, or automation tools such as Microsoft Excel, Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, or SQL
* Experience documenting business requirements, process flows, or functional specifications
* Experience supporting testing, validation, or implementation activities for technology or process-change projects

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with tax applications such as OneSource, Vertex, Avalara, or CorpTax
* Experience on tax transformation, ERP, or finance transformation projects
* Experience working with cross-functional teams across tax, finance, and technology
* Experience with workflow or automation tools such as Power Automate or Power Apps
* Chartered Accountant, MBA, M.Com, or comparable postgraduate qualification

title: F - RC - Actuarial - UK PC - Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Staff, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines
*.*
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Seniors, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Estimate actuarial liability for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 and Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 1+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx etc, will be a plus
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting.
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Manager Operations – Mutual Fund Accounting.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Statutory Reporting team prepares and review Financial Statements comprising of Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss Account, Cash Flow Statement, Notes on Accounts and other Annexures to Annual or Interim Reports like Statement of Investments, Statement of Changes in Capital etc. for set of Funds administered by Markets and Securities Services globally.
* Performance Reporting Team is responsible for reporting accurate, consistent and timely analysis of all funds under management, including performance measurement, asset allocation, portfolio analysis and risk measures (post Net Asset Value processes). Life Fund Accounting Team is required to provide the provision of monthly reports and data extracts to Insurance clients. The core deliverables include ledger feeds, valuation extracts and supplementary analysis to enable the client to complete statutory accounts and regulatory disclosures. Also required to oversee the entire monthly reporting process
* To manage the Statutory Reporting, Performance Reporting and Life Fund Accounting team in Kolkata and ensure accurate, complete and timely delivery of the outputs. The role can be an individual contributor role or people manager. Responsible for keeping abreast with new pronouncements by various governing and accounting bodies
* Contribute to meeting the cost targets. Managing the process to meet or exceed Service Level Agreement / Performance Level Agreements. Using performance/attribution software, create, quality control and distribute monthly results for all clients to agreed levels, formats and deadlines. Update monthly fund benchmarks and keeping abreast of market and index developments. Carry out post month end control checks for Life & Insurance clients within agreed service levels and to a high standard of accuracy.
* Provide ledger feeds, valuation extracts and supplementary analysis to enable the client to complete statutory accounts and regulatory disclosures. Review all investment accounting reports required by the client to support the general ledger feed. Oversee the entire monthly reporting process. Ongoing resource management to minimize, impact of attrition. Continuous monitoring of production calendar to meet Business Needs. Management Information’s are provided timely and accurately.
* Review and authorize all investment accounting reports produced. All Key Performance Indicators, accuracy targets and Service Level Agreements are met. Engagement with Business Areas to understand and work on improving customer satisfaction. Proactively identify and improve service delivery. Driving key streamlining initiatives. Effective resource allocation and management
* Review progress of team members and provide necessary training and support. Adherence to the Group’s agreed processes / procedures – achieving a satisfactory Audit report. Regularly review operational effectiveness and regularly review procedures. Updating all daily MIS (Management Information System) / trackers as required by the process. Ensure timely follow up on the open & outstanding issues that hinder the valuation. Ensure, Escalation Matrix is followed as per agreed between Business Partners and Markets and Securities Services Kolkata.
* Undertake/participate in projects for improvement in delivery quality and/or timeliness. Identify and reduce manual processes for enhanced operational control. Support and implement technology upgradation. Continually raising the risks that have been identified / observed in department processes and procedures. Support audit process and recommendations on a timely manner. Perform the fund’s activities correctly as per the Standard Operating Procedures, Checklist and controls.

**To Be Successful, You Will**

* Commerce graduate or post-graduate with relevant working experience.
* Professional qualification in the fields of Accounting like CA (Chartered Accountant), ICWA (Institute of Cost and Works Accountants), CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) and CS (Company Secretary) with relevant working experience.
* 5+ Years of experience in fund accounting, Net Asset Value, Gross Asset Value and Mutual Funds.
* Strong Accounting Concepts with a clear understanding of financial statements. Sound knowledge of various types of assets, Funds Administration and accounting services and understanding of valuations cycle, financial instruments, corporate actions and accounting concepts.
* Understanding of the Accounting Standards and the ability to relate them to the disclosures in the Financial Statements. Exposure to IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) and US GAAP (United States Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) will be desirable. Knowledge of types of Performance Reporting and calculations employed in the industry.
* An understanding of investment instruments and how they are processed for performance calculation purposes is required. Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word skills. IOC (Investment Operations Certificate) / CISI (Chartered Institute for Securities & Investment) certification would be an added advantage.
* Understanding of Cash reconciliation, Income and Expense would be an added advantage. Knowledge of Bloomberg, Reuters and relevant data feeds would be added advantage. Should have an eye for detail and a strong analytical mind.
* Efficient Time Management and ability to multi task work and prioritize to meet defined deadlines. Should be able to communicate effectively with overseas customers and employees. Proactive in accomplishing tasks without being asked to do so.

description:

**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service**
. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

**About the Role**

The corporate ecosystem needs tailored solutions to solve financial needs in a globally knit business environment. As an Accounts Manager - Transaction Banking Group, you will have the opportunity to manage the global trade finance, cash management (including payments and receivables), and banking needs of corporate clients. In addition, the role encompasses servicing client requirements across the financial spectrum. Hence, it is imperative that you analyze the available data to understand the client persona and subsequently offer the right solutions as part of the 360-degree banking framework. Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.
  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. title: CA Article Trainee and Paid up Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
Bhatter Singhania & Associates, founded in 2016, is a Chartered Accountancy firm focused on delivering reliable and personalized financial solutions. With its registered office in Kolkata and a branch in Varanasi, the firm serves clients across diverse sectors with strong professional standards and integrity. The team emphasizes building long-term relationships based on trust and a thorough understanding of each client’s specific requirements. Bhatter Singhania & Associates positions itself as a strategic partner in clients’ growth journeys, rather than just a service provider. Key service areas include accounting and financial reporting, income tax and GST advisory, ROC and corporate compliance, and international and NRI taxation.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata for a CA Article Trainee and Paid up Assistant. The role involves assisting in accounting and financial reporting, preparing and reviewing working papers, and supporting statutory and tax audits under supervision. Responsibilities include drafting and filing income tax and GST returns, supporting ROC filings and corporate compliance documentation, and helping with basic research on tax and regulatory matters. The trainee and assistant will interact with clients for data collection and clarification, maintain organized records and workpapers, and contribute to the timely completion of assignments. The role also includes learning and applying professional standards, participating in internal training, and supporting senior team members in day-to-day firm operations.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess a strong foundation in accounting and financial reporting, including familiarity with basic standards and ledger maintenance.
* Candidates should possess skills in direct and indirect taxation, including income tax computation, GST concepts, and basic knowledge of ROC and corporate compliance.
* Candidates should possess analytical and research skills, with the ability to interpret financial data and refer to relevant tax and regulatory materials.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word), basic accounting software, and the ability to prepare clear working papers and documentation.
* Candidates should possess good written and verbal communication skills, professional ethics, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively in a team.
* CA Article Trainee: Should be registered or eligible to register for articleship under ICAI; Paid up Assistant: Commerce graduate or equivalent with a strong accounting background.
* Prior internship or experience in a CA firm, familiarity with Indian tax laws and compliance procedures, and willingness to learn and take responsibility are beneficial.

title: Senior QS & Billing Expert
description:
Job Description (JD) – Senior QS & Billing Expert – Railway Project
  
  
**Position:**
Senior QS & Billing Expert
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ Years
  
  
**Qualification:**
Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) from a recognized university.
  
  
**Location:**
Railway Project Site
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Senior QS & Billing Expert will be responsible for quantity surveying, measurement, billing, cost monitoring, contract administration, and commercial management of railway civil infrastructure works, ensuring accurate billing and compliance with contract conditions, specifications, and project requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Review and verify contractor measurements, RA bills, final bills, and supporting documents.
* Prepare and check detailed quantities, BOQs, rate analysis, and cost estimates for civil and railway infrastructure works.
* Monitor quantities executed at site and reconcile them with approved drawings, BOQ, and contract provisions.
* Conduct joint measurements with contractors and site teams and maintain accurate measurement records.
* Review variation claims, extra items, deviation statements, and rate analysis for additional works.
* Monitor project costs, quantities, and expenditure against the approved budget and contract value.
* Assist in contract administration, including interpretation of BOQ, specifications, payment terms, and contractual provisions.
* Review contractor submissions related to claims, extensions of time, escalation, and other commercial matters.
* Coordinate with engineering, planning, construction, and project management teams for timely resolution of billing and quantity-related issues.
* Maintain records of measurements, bills, variations, quantities, and commercial correspondence.
* Prepare monthly commercial reports, cost statements, quantity reconciliation, and billing status reports.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, contract conditions, Indian Railways/RDSO requirements, and applicable standards.
* Support the Project Manager in commercial and contractual matters related to railway civil works.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Quantity Surveying, billing, measurement, BOQ, rate analysis, and cost control.
* Good understanding of civil construction contracts and contract administration.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, AutoCAD, and quantity/billing software.
* Ability to independently verify contractor bills and assess quantities at site.
* Strong analytical, numerical, documentation, and reporting skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills with contractors and project stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary project environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in Quantity Surveying, Billing, Cost Control, or Commercial Management.
* Experience in railway/metro infrastructure projects will be preferred.
* Experience in civil works such as railway formation, earthwork, bridges, culverts, stations, drainage, and other infrastructure works.
* Experience in EPC/Item Rate/Construction Contracts, contractor billing, variations, claims, and final account settlement.
* Knowledge of Indian Railways, RDSO, Metro Rail standards, SOR/DSR, and railway contract procedures will be an advantage.

Key Deliverables
  
  

* Accurate and timely verification of contractor bills and measurements.
* Effective monitoring and reconciliation of quantities and project costs.
* Proper assessment and documentation of variations, claims, and additional works.
* Timely commercial and billing reports for project management.
* Compliance with contractual, technical, and financial requirements.
* Effective support to project management in QS, billing, and contract administration matters.

title: Manager Purchase
description:
Position Summary
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Management & Strategic Sourcing
* Lead end-to-end category management and strategic procurement for capital equipment (Greenfield & Rebuild projects), MRO, and spare parts categories.
* Own the complete equipment build cycle: source individual parts, sub-assemblies, and heavy components from a global and domestic supplier base, coordinate inbound logistics, and support in-house assembly and trial runs.
* Prepare component-level budgets for new products, conduct comprehensive market and industry research to inform category strategies, and collaborate with business area stakeholders for project estimation and cost modelling.
* Establish and maintain framework agreements, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), price benchmarking tools, and should-cost models for diverse equipment and spare parts.
* Supplier Development, De-risking & Cost Optimization
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic suppliers; assess and enhance existing supplier capacities across Quality, Delivery, and Cost (QDC) parameters.
* Drive cost-saving initiatives through competitive tendering, strategic bundling, group purchasing volumes, and alternative supplier development (e.g., building robust local/national models to mitigate foreign supply chain dependencies).
* Perform sub-assembly level risk assessments before ordering, develop secondary/alternative sources to de-risks supply chains, and maintain production continuity.
* Act as the primary commercial point of contact for key partners, managing supplier performance evaluations and sharing insights transparently across internal engineering, production, and quality teams.
* Cross-functional Collaboration & Quality Compliance
* Partner closely with design, production, and quality assurance teams during assembly and trial phases to resolve part deviations, manage supplier claims, and ensure strict technical conformity.
* Ensure full compliance with corporate sourcing policies, internal approval workflows, ISO standards, and corporate procurement audits.
* Drive internal restructuring initiatives to optimize procurement performance, fostering clear accountability across specialized purchase, sourcing, and supply chain verticals.
* Digital Transformation & Systems Excellence
* Leverage advanced procurement tools—specifically SAP HANA (MM & SH modules) and JAGGAER (RFX, Auctions, SRM, Supplier Evaluation, and Spend Analytics)—to drive process transparency and data integrity.
* Manage vendor onboarding onto digital platforms, facilitating EDI-based data exchange, order confirmation, and digital offer submissions.
* Train cross-functional teams (Purchase, Quality, and Shipping) and external suppliers on digital procurement modules to enhance department-wide response efficiency and reporting accuracy.

Supporting each global product on a regional basis by function or market.

Evidence of strong analytical, statistical and data mining skills to study trends, make projections and to interpret numeric information. Evidence of strong operational decision making and be able to provide support to the teams. Experience of successfully managing and developing a team/Individuals in previous role

Proven ability to initiate cost control measures by achieving resource efficiency and managing overheads. Will be expected to maintain HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, together with any issues raised by external regulators.
* Must be aware of the operational risk scenarios associated with this role and act upon pertinent risk (if any). Responsible for the implementation of Group Compliance Policy as is applicable to this role. The role will require technical excellence to achieve target deliverables combined with the ability to get work done from administrators/SMEs to achieve target KPIs. The role will demand a daily balance of delivering an excellent client service within the standard model of promoting continuous improvement of processes and of identifying and capitalizing opportunities to create capacity and generate efficiencies
* Graduate/Postgraduate in commerce stream, MBA, MBA Finance. 10 years of relevant experience for an internal Candidate, 12 + years of experience for an external candidate. Must with strong knowledge of credit products in banking, post approval, lending docs, loan processing. Excellent verbal & written communication skills. Strong negotiation & persuasive skills. High level variation and specific manual processes required by Product/System/Client/jurisdiction

description:
* We are looking for a qualified and experienced Chartered Accountant (CA) to lead the accounting and finance operations of a diversified business group engaged in manufacturing, trading, and logistics.
* The ideal candidate will have strong practical experience in managing books of accounts, supervising junior accountants, coordinating with banks and auditors, and ensuring timely financial reporting and statutory compliance across multiple group companies.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Accounting & Financial Management**

* Oversee day-to-day accounting operations and maintenance of books of accounts for multiple group companies.
* Ensure accurate recording of financial transactions, ledger scrutiny, and periodic reconciliations.
* Supervise monthly and annual closing of accounts, including preparation of financial statements, Balance Sheets, and P&L statements.
* Monitor accounts payable, receivable, cash flow, and working capital requirements.

**2. Team Leadership & Supervision**

* Lead, guide, and supervise a team of junior accountants.
* Review accounting entries, reconciliations, and financial reports prepared by the team.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure accuracy and timely completion of accounting activities.

**3. Banking & Audit Coordination**

* Act as the primary point of contact for bankers, statutory auditors, tax auditors, and financial consultants.
* Manage banking relationships, documentation, reconciliations, and credit facility-related requirements.
* Coordinate internal and statutory audits, ensuring timely submission of financial records and supporting documentation.
* Resolve audit observations and ensure necessary corrective actions.

**4. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Oversee GST, TDS, Income Tax, and other applicable statutory compliances.
* Ensure timely filing of returns and compliance with relevant accounting standards and regulations.
* Coordinate with external consultants and professionals for tax assessments and regulatory matters.

**5. Manufacturing & Trading Accounts**

* Oversee accounting relating to manufacturing, trading, inventory, purchases, and sales.
* Monitor stock reconciliations, inventory valuation, costing, and expense allocation.
* Review logistics and transportation-related expenses and financial transactions.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) from ICAI.
* Approximately 4 years of relevant experience, preferably in manufacturing and trading businesses.
* Proven experience supervising or managing a team of accountants.
* Strong understanding of accounting, taxation, auditing, and financial reporting.
* Practical experience coordinating with banks, auditors, and external financial stakeholders.
* Experience managing accounts for multiple companies or business entities is highly preferred.
* Proficiency in Tally/Tally Prime, MS Excel, and accounting software.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organisational skills.
* Ability to independently manage accounting operations and meet reporting deadlines.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a hands-on Chartered Accountant who can take ownership of the group's accounting function, efficiently manage a team, and independently coordinate with bankers and auditors.

**Candidates with prior experience in manufacturing, trading, or diversified business groups will be preferred.**

•      Reconcile bank accounts, vendor and customer ledgers every month.

•      Manage accounts payable for tea suppliers, packaging vendors, co-packers, logistics and service providers.

•      Prepare month-end closing entries, provisions and accruals; support quarterly and annual closing.

•      Coordinate with the statutory auditor and tax consultant; prepare audit schedules.

2. Marketplace reconciliation (Amazon, Flipkart and others)

•      Download and reconcile settlement / payment reports from Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub and other platforms with orders booked.

•      Track and account for commissions, fixed closing fees, shipping fees, storage (FBA / Flipkart warehouse) fees, advertising spend and other deductions.

•      Identify short payments, unclaimed reimbursements, lost or damaged inventory claims (e.g. SAFE-T, SPF) and follow up until recovered.

•      Reconcile returns: units returned vs. units received back in saleable or damaged condition.

•      Maintain a platform-wise receivables tracker and ageing.

3. GST and other compliance

•      Prepare data for GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, including state-wise sales from marketplace reports.

•      Reconcile TCS collected by e-commerce operators (GSTR-8) and TDS (Section 194-O) deducted by platforms with Form 26AS / AIS and books.

•      Reconcile input tax credit with GSTR-2B.

•      Handle GST registrations / additional places of business where stock is held in marketplace warehouses (in coordination with the consultant).

•      Track TDS payable, monthly deposits and quarterly returns; generate e-way bills and e-invoices where required.

4. Manufacturing module

•      Set up and maintain the Bill of Materials (BOM) for each SKU: loose tea, blends, packaging material (pouches, cartons, labels), and other inputs.

•      Record production / manufacturing journals for each batch, including job-work or co-packer production.

•      Track material consumption, wastage and yield against standard; report variances.

•      Calculate cost of production and per-unit cost for every SKU and pack size.

•      Maintain batch numbers, manufacturing and expiry dates as required for food (FSSAI) compliance.

5. Inventory module

•      Maintain stock records for raw tea, packaging material, work-in-progress and finished goods across all locations: own warehouse, co-packer, and marketplace fulfilment centres (FBA, Flipkart Smart Fulfilment, etc.).

•      Record stock transfers to marketplace warehouses and reconcile with platform inventory reports.

•      Conduct monthly physical stock counts and reconcile with books; investigate and report differences.

•      Track near-expiry, damaged and slow-moving stock; flag reorder levels to the operations team.

•      Value closing inventory correctly for monthly and annual accounts.

6. MIS and reporting

•      Prepare monthly MIS: sales by platform and SKU, gross margin, platform fees as % of sales, return rates, and stock position.

•      Prepare SKU-wise and platform-wise profitability statements.

•      Track cash flow, receivables from platforms and payables to vendors.

•      Support budgeting and pricing decisions with cost data.

Who we are looking forMust have

•      B.Com / M.Com with 3–6 years of accounting experience.

•      At least 2 years in a company selling online through Amazon, Flipkart or similar marketplaces.

•      Hands-on experience reconciling marketplace settlement reports, fees, returns and claims.

•      Working knowledge of the manufacturing (BOM / production) and inventory modules in Tally Prime or a similar ERP like Zoho.

•      Sound practical knowledge of GST (including e-commerce TCS), TDS and month-end closing.

•      Good Excel skills: VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP, pivot tables, SUMIFS, and handling large report downloads.

•      Fluent in English and Hindi or Bengali, with clear written communication.

Good to have

•      CA Inter / CMA Inter.

•      Experience in FMCG or food and beverage, ideally tea, spices or similar packaged goods.

•      Exposure to Zoho Books / Zoho Inventory, Busy, or inventory tools such as Unicommerce or EasyEcom.

•      Familiarity with quick-commerce platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart) and their reports.

•      Basic understanding of FSSAI batch and labelling requirements.

Personal qualities

•      Detail-oriented, with a habit of reconciling until the numbers match.

•      Works independently and meets deadlines without close supervision.

•      Comfortable working with operations and warehouse teams to trace stock.

Compensation and how to apply

•      
**CTC:**
Up to ₹5,00,000 per annum, depending on experience and skills. Includes statutory benefits (PF, ESI where applicable, gratuity) as per law.

•      
**Working days:**
Monday to Saturday, with 2nd and 4th Saturdays Off. Office-based in Kolkata.

•      
**Notice period:**
Immediate joiners or up to 30 days preferred.

title: Chartering Manager
description:
**Experience:**
10–15 Years

**Preferred Background:**
Relevant shore-based Chartering experience in the Maritime Transportation sector for Bulk Carriers ( Containers exposure is an added advantage ). Sailing exposure as Chief Mate/Master is good to have.

**Joining Location**
- Kolkata

**Role Purpose**

To lead the
**Chartering & Commercial function**
, ensuring optimum vessel employment, competitive chartering revenue, minimum commercial downtime, effective Charter Party management, timely commercial and claims settlement, and development of new business opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Chartering & Revenue**

* Identify and secure suitable employment for Dry Bulk vessels through
  **Tenders, Voyage Charter and Time Charter**
  opportunities.
* For non-tender vessels, strive to secure charter rates at around
  **95% of the prevailing BDI / relevant BKI, BSI or corresponding market index**
  for the vessel tonnage.
* Evaluate market conditions, vessel positioning, cargo availability and prevailing fixtures before concluding employment.
* Explore
  **3–6 month period employment linked to BDI/FFA scales**
  for identified vessels, based on market opportunities.
* Negotiate freight/hire rates and commercial terms with charterers and brokers within the approved authority framework.

**2. Chartering Efficiency & Vessel Utilisation**

* Minimise commercial off-hire and waiting time between completion of one employment /tender and commencement of the next, and minimise avoidable commercial downtime and loss of earnings.
* Plan vessel repositioning and re-hire opportunities to maximise
  **earning days and fleet utilisation**
  .
* Evaluate options based on recent comparable fixtures for similar tonnage in the relevant region.

**3. Voyage Estimation & Commercial Performance**

* Prepare voyage estimates before fixing Voyage Charters and assess expected
  **TCE and voyage profitability**
  .
* Prepare voyage actuals on completion and analyse variance against estimates.
* Monitor vessel earnings and analyse losses arising from
  **off-hire, idling, ballast, repairs and other commercial downtime**
  .
* Prepare voyage analysis, variance and commercial loss reports for Management review.

**4. Charter Party Management**

* Review fixture recaps and
  **Charter Party terms**
  thoroughly before conclusion.
* Ensure Charter Party terms adequately protect the
  **Owner’s commercial interests**
  and minimise revenue leakage.
* Track disputes arising from concluded Charter Parties and ensure learnings are incorporated into future fixtures.
* Work towards minimising Charter Party disputes and their impact on vessel earnings.

**5. Business Development**

* Identify and develop new
  **chartering, cargo and commercial business opportunities**
  for the Company.
* Drive growth and utilisation of identified business segments and vessels in line with Management targets.
* Explore
  **new container business opportunities and sectors**
  , in addition to the existing Chennai–Kolkata sector.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with
  **charterers, cargo owners, brokers and other commercial partners**
  .

**6. Hire, Receivables & Commercial Closure**

* Ensure timely receipt and settlement of
  **hire/freight and additional recoverable**
  , including AWRP, bunker payments and other applicable amounts.
* Target commercial closure and collection of outstanding amounts
  **within 15 days from completion/end of charter**
  , wherever contractually applicable.
* Coordinate with Finance & Accounts for timely reconciliation and closure of commercial receivables.
* Follow up on outstanding commercial dues and ensure timely escalation wherever required.

**7. Claims & Insurance**

* Coordinate and follow up
  **P&I, H&M, commercial, cargo and other applicable insurance claims**
  .
* Liaise with insurers, P&I Clubs and underwriters for timely processing and settlement of claims.
* Ensure proper documentation and systematic record keeping of claims, correspondence and settlements.
* Support
  **insurance renewals, negotiations and settlements**
  with appropriate Management approval.

**8. Commercial MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare monthly
  **fleet earnings and commercial performance reports**
  within defined timelines.
* Report vessel utilisation, waiting periods, commercial downtime, voyage performance and loss of earnings.
* Support performance reports with relevant
  **freight market and BDI analysis**
  .
* Prepare quarterly and annual commercial analysis and reports required by the CEO and Management/Board.
* Highlight key commercial risks, performance gaps and opportunities for Management review.

**9. Tenders & Commercial Documentation**

* Prepare and review commercial documents for
  **vessel and cargo tenders**
  .
* Ensure accurate and timely submission of tender documentation.
* Maintain proper documentation, approvals and records relating to
  **fixtures, Charter Parties, tenders, claims and other commercial transactions**
  .

**10. Vessel Sale & Purchase Support**

* Assist the CEO in commercial matters relating to the
  **purchase and sale of vessels**
  , as required.
* Review relevant vessel particulars and commercial documentation.
* Provide commercial inputs and analysis to support Management evaluation and decision-making.

**Skills & Competence**

* Strong understanding of
  **Dry Bulk freight markets, Voyage Charter and Time Charter**
  .
* Good network and relationships with
  **charterers, cargo owners, brokers and other industry stakeholders**
  .
* Strong
  **commercial negotiation, analytical and decision-making skills**
  .
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
* Commercially driven with a strong focus on
  **revenue, vessel utilisation, cost optimisation and profitability**
  .

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a skilled Senior Regulatory Reporting Professional to support the delivery of technology-enabled regulatory reporting services for digital asset clients. The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.
* Broader Banking Regulatory Reporting Exposure: Apply relevant exposure to banking regulatory returns, including capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, ICAAP reporting, balance sheet reporting, and regulatory disclosures, where applicable to the client’s operating model.
* Regulatory Change, Awareness & Reporting Logic: Monitor relevant regulatory developments, interpret reporting instructions, assess data and process impacts, and coordinate timely updates to reporting logic, templates, procedures, controls, and technology workflows.
* Data Sourcing & Analytical Reviews: Perform complex data extraction, validation, variance analysis, and root-cause exception investigations across large datasets to ensure data completeness and integrity.
* Control Governance & Audit Readiness: Embed rigorous quality controls—including maker-checker reviews, clear audit trails, evidence retention, and sign-off protocols—across all reporting cycles.
* Automation & Process Improvement: Identify reporting process inefficiencies and support automation initiatives using tools such as SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
* Analytics & Responsible AI Awareness: Apply awareness of responsible AI and analytics use cases to support anomaly detection, exception analysis, reporting commentary, and workflow monitoring.
* Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment: Provide technical coaching and review support to junior team members while coordinating seamlessly across cross-functional partners and U.S.-based stakeholders.
* Time-Zone Flexibility: Willingness to operate during late/extended hours to ensure seamless hand-offs with U.S.-based stakeholders and meet strict global submission deadlines.
* Al fluency - Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* 4–6 years of relevant experience, including 2–3 years in a senior role within regulatory reporting or financial services.
* Hands-on experience with U.S. regulatory filings, financial condition reporting, customer liability reporting, permissible investments, transaction reporting, and Money Transmitter License (MTL) submissions.
* Hands-on experience in FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .
* Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field is preferred; CA, CPA, CFA, MBA, or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
* Strong end-to-end understanding of regulatory reporting production cycles, data validation, reconciliations, variance analysis, workpaper preparation, and review controls.
* Solid working knowledge of financial statement analysis, regulatory capital concepts, ICAAP reporting, and applicable regulatory compliance frameworks.
* Exposure to banking regulatory reporting frameworks, including capital adequacy, ICAAP reporting, liquidity risk reporting, balance sheet schedules, and regulatory disclosures, would be beneficial.
* Proven ability to translate complex regulatory mandates into business requirements.
* Knowledge of reporting platforms and data tools, along with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Snowflake, or Looker, would be an added advantage.
* Awareness of Generative AI tools and workflow automation to support data extraction, exception analysis, and reporting efficiency would be an advantage.
* Strong control mindset, including practical experience with maker-checker reviews, robust audit trails, evidence retention, issue management, and key risk/control testing.
* Advanced data analytics skills, with the ability to query large datasets, perform root-cause analysis on exceptions, and communicate structured findings clearly.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effectively managing relationships across onshore/offshore teams, product managers, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating strong ownership, continuous improvement, and agility in adapting to evolving regulatory landscapes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required. U.S. visa readiness or international travel willingness is preferred but not mandatory.

**ROLE SUMMARY**
:
  
  
The Portfolio Head (AVP) is responsible for managing, monitoring, and supporting the incubator’s portfolio of startups. The Portfolio AVP shall primarily focus on
**post-incubation venture management, portfolio performance, strategic interventions, fundraising readiness, business growth, corporate and market linkages, governance, risk management and value creation**
and shall act as a strategic partner to founders, tracking their progress, connecting them with mentors, and ensuring alignment with program goals. This position is central to developing a thriving startup ecosystem and driving measurable outcomes across the incubator.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Portfolio Management & Founder Support
* Act as the main point of contact for all incubated startups.
* Track startup progress across milestones—product development, customer traction, revenue, funding, and compliance.
* Conduct regular check-ins, review sessions, and performance assessments with founders.
* Identify needs, challenges, and growth opportunities for each startup.
* Incubation Program Execution
* Coordinate workshops, masterclasses, demo days, and pitching sessions.
* Ensure startups receive timely access to mentorship, technical support, and domain-specific resources.
* Mentor & Network Engagement
* Build and maintain a strong pool of mentors, industry experts, investors, and corporate partners.
* Facilitate one-on-one mentor meetings and structured advisory sessions.
* Match mentors to startups based on sector, stage, and specific needs.
* Monitoring, Evaluation & Reporting
* Maintain detailed records and dashboards of startup performance metrics.
* Create monthly/quarterly progress reports for leadership, funding agencies, and stakeholders.
* Monitor compliance with incubator policies, grant guidelines, and reporting formats (if government-funded).
* Investment & Funding Support
* Help startups refine pitch decks, financial models, and investor documents.
* Facilitate investor introductions, due diligence support, and participation in demo days.
* Identify grants, competitions, and funding opportunities for portfolio startups.
* Ecosystem Partnerships
* Develop relationships with corporates, universities, research labs, market access partners, and government bodies for clinic & market validation.
* Identify collaboration opportunities, pilot projects, and go-to-market support for startups.
* Program Strategy & Continuous Improvement
* Analyze portfolio performance trends to improve future cohort design and operational efficiency.
* Recommend new tools, platforms, and frameworks for portfolio management.
* Support creation of founder resources—playbooks, templates, guidelines, SOPs

**Required Skills**

* Understanding of startup lifecycle, fundraising, business models, and market validation.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple startups with diverse needs in a fast-paced ecosystem.
* Strong analytical and documentation skills with familiarity in CRM tools, dashboards, and portfolio tracking software.
* Highly proactive, relationship-driven, and comfortable working with founders at different stages.

**Key Competencies**

* Measurable progress of portfolio startups (KPIs: traction, revenue, pilots, funding, product readiness).
* High-quality mentor engagement and founder satisfaction.
* Accurate portfolio dashboards, impact reports, and documentation.
* Successful demo days, investor connects, and external stakeholder engagements.

**Academic Qualification**

* Master’s degree in Management, Business, Engineering, Entrepreneurship, or related fields or qualified CA/ICWAI
* Additional certifications in startup management, innovation, or venture finance is desirable

**Experience**

* Total years of work experience: 10 + years
* Minimum years of relevant experience: 8 years
* Minimum years of work experience after essential qualification: 8 years

title: Customer Support
description:
Job Description: Refund, Loan & Dispute Operations Executive - Customer Support
  
  
**Role Overview:**
We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and ownership-driven Refund, Loan & Dispute Operations Executive to manage refund calculations, loan/EMI-related cases, non-starter loan cases, financial disputes, transaction reconciliation, and customer resolutions. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with Customer Support, Sales, Finance, Escalation teams, and external loan/financial partners to ensure that every assigned case is accurately analyzed, properly coordinated, and taken to end-to-end closure.
  
  
This is a numbers, data, and ownership-driven role. The candidate should be comfortable working with financial data, Excel/Google Sheets, transaction records, and customers.
  
  
Position Details
  
  

* Employment Type: Full-Time
* Department: Customer Support
* Experience: 1-3 years
* Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / BBA / Finance-related qualification preferred
* Location: Kolkata

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Refund Calculation & Processing:

+ Calculate refund amounts accurately as per the refund policy, payment mode, programme access, and applicable deductions.
+ Validate refund eligibility by checking payment records, enrolment details, and supporting documents.
+ Verify payment proofs, transaction IDs, and invoices before any refund is initiated.
+ Manage the complete refund lifecycle from request → verification → approval → payout → closure.
+ Ensure refunds are processed only after obtaining the required approvals.
+ Follow up on failed, delayed, or reversed refunds until the amount is credited to the customer.

* Loan & EMI Case Management:

+ Handle loan/EMI-related cases for customers who have purchased programmes through loan or financing partners.
+ Verify and provide accurate information on EMI amount, EMI deduction history, EMI commencement date, tenure, outstanding amount, and payment/loan status.
+ Manage loan cancellations, incorrect deductions, and loan closure/foreclosure-related requests in coordination with the loan partner.
+ Analyse and manage non-starter loan cases, and coordinate with the loan partner to resolve them as per the agreed process.
+ Proactively connect with learners/customers in non-starter loan cases to understand the reason for non-start, provide clarity on loan/EMI status and next steps, and ensure the learner understands the resolution.

* Financial Dispute Resolution:

+ Handle payment disputes, chargebacks, double debits, and failed transactions where the amount was debited.
+ Investigate each case using transaction records, payment gateway data, bank references, and customer communication.
+ Prepare the required documents and evidence to respond to disputes raised through payment gateways, banks, or partners within timelines.
+ Own the dispute end-to-end after raising it with the concerned POC, including regular follow-ups, TAT monitoring, escalation of delays, validation of the resolution, and formal closure of the case.
+ Escalate complex, high-value, or suspicious cases for appropriate review.

* Transaction Reconciliation:

+ Reconcile transactions across payment gateway reports, bank statements, sales/CRM records, and loan partner reports.
+ Identify mismatches, duplicate payments, unmapped payments, and pending settlements.
+ Coordinate with the Finance team to resolve discrepancies and close open items.

* Customer Resolution & Case Closure:

+ Communicate with customers on refund, loan, and dispute cases in a clear, professional, and empathetic manner.
+ Explain refund calculations, loan status, and expected timelines to customers in simple terms.
+ Prioritize cases based on financial impact, customer impact, ageing, defined TAT, and escalation severity, ensuring that high-value and critical cases receive timely attention.
+ Resolve escalated customer cases within the defined TAT.
+ Reconnect with the learner/customer after internal resolution wherever required and provide clear closure, including the action taken, final outcome, and any further steps expected from them.

* Stakeholder & Partner Coordination:

+ Coordinate with Customer Support, Sales, Finance, Escalation teams, and external loan/financial partners.
+ Follow up on pending approvals, partner responses, payouts, and documentation.
+ Identify recurring issues and process gaps, and recommend improvements for better control, speed, and transparency.

* Reporting & Record Management:

+ Maintain tracking sheets of refunds, loan cases, and disputes using Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
+ Prepare regular MIS reports on case volumes, refund value, pending cases, and closure rates for management review.
+ Ensure all records and supporting documents are properly organized and readily available for review.

* Confidentiality & Financial Control:

+ Maintain strict confidentiality of customer and company financial information.
+ Handle bank details, loan information, and transaction data responsibly.
+ Support controls that minimize errors, duplicate refunds, misuse, and unauthorized payouts.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* B.Com / M.Com / BBA / Finance-related qualification preferred.
* 1-3 years of experience in refund operations, loan/EMI operations, payment disputes, reconciliation, finance operations, or a similar role.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIF/COUNTIF, filters).
* Good understanding of payment flows, EMIs/loans, refunds, chargebacks, and transaction records.
* Experience handling loan/EMI queries (EMI deductions, tenure, outstanding amount, foreclosure) will be a strong advantage.
* Ability to perform accurate financial calculations and analyze transaction data.
* Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for customer and partner interactions.

Key Personal Attributes
  
  

* Good organizational, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Comfortable coordinating with customers, internal teams, and external partners.
* High integrity and strong ethical standards.
* Analytical and detail-oriented.
* Strong ownership and accountability till case closure.
* Calm and patient while handling escalated customers.
* Process-driven with good judgment.
* Comfortable handling sensitive financial information.
* Ability to work independently and maintain accurate records.

What We Offer
  
  

* Opportunity to work closely with the Customer Support, Finance & Operations teams.
* Hands-on exposure to refund operations, loan/EMI processes, payment disputes, and reconciliation.
* Opportunity to build and improve refund and dispute resolution processes.
* Growth opportunity within a fast-paced organization.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Led deployment of Manufacturing Excellence work processes across multiple sites, ensuring standardization, capability building, governance, and sustainable performance improvement

* Facilitated change management, leadership coaching, and frontline capability development to accelerate adoption of new operating standards and embed a continuous improvement culture.
* Designing and implementing EY Smart factory solution

* Working knowledge of manufacturing and enterprise systems including MES, ERP (SAP preferred), QMS, CMMS/EAM platforms, Industrial IoT applications, and manufacturing analytics solutions
* Assisting in digital shop floor transformation and implement modern technology solutions enabling Factory of the Future
* Strong analytical skill to handle structured and unstructured data generated during manufacturing process and ability to devise meaningful stories around the same
* Established transformation governance mechanisms, site maturity assessments, benefit tracking, and performance review routines to ensure realization and sustainability of business outcomes
* Participate actively in building an industry focused practice across EY GDS service lines
* Identify opportunities, lead others to follow your unique solutions to unstructured problems
* Ability to share and interact with CXOs and present them with rational way forward and solutions
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong core consulting skills, including problem solving, analytical thinking, primary and secondary research, logical structuring, storyboarding, and executive-level presentations
* Strong leadership and project management skills with the ability to manage complex transformation initiatives
* Strong change management and stakeholder engagement skills, with experience driving organizational adoption and leading cross-functional teams through transformation programs.
* Self-motivated, innovative, and collaborative team player capable of thriving in dynamic client environments
* Strong presentation, verbal, and written communication skills, with experience interacting with shop-floor teams, plant leadership, CXOs, and global stakeholders
* Exceptional attention to detail, responsiveness, and a proven track record of delivering high-impact outcomes
* Ability to identify opportunities, solve unstructured problems, and develop practical, value-driven recommendations for clients
* Strong business acumen and stakeholder management capabilities, coupled with a hands-on implementation mindset

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Experience with manufacturing analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, Minitab, Advanced Excel, or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing and enterprise systems including MES, ERP (SAP preferred), QMS, CMMS/EAM, APS, SCADA, Historian, and Industrial IoT platforms.
* Experience in data-driven performance improvement, manufacturing analytics, and operational decision support.
* Exposure to supply chain planning, inventory optimization, production planning, and manufacturing network optimization initiatives.
* Understanding of change management frameworks, capability building approaches, and organizational transformation methodologies.
* Experience working across global and multi-site transformation programs

**What We Look For**

* MBA from VLM programs (IIM C, IIM M (formerly NTIE) etc.), or a Tier-I institution, preferably with a specialization in Operations Management, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or a related field
* 6-10 years of experience in Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, Performance Improvement, Reliability, Maintenance, Supply Chain Operations, or Manufacturing Transformation
* Solid knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Six Sigma, Operational Excellence, Industry 4.0, and Digital Transformation methodologies
* At-least 2-3 years of hands-on implementation consulting experience deploying Manufacturing Excellence systems, Continuous Improvement programs, Reliability Excellence initiatives, and performance management frameworks
* Prior experience working with a leading management consulting, operations consulting, manufacturing transformation consulting, or operations excellence advisory organization
* Demonstrated experience in end-to-end client delivery, including assessment, solution design, implementation, stakeholder management, and benefits realization
* Willingness to travel internationally on short- and medium-term assignments, as required

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

 Complex Engagement Support

description:

**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. The creation and delivery of presentations to cross functional audiences is essential. In addition, there is on\-going responsibilities for maintaining key performance reporting and strategy documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own loss mitigation program reporting and analytics: Create materials and lead monthly presentation to Collections Leadership. Create required quarterly OCC loss mitigation volume and performance presentation slides. Interpret performance and clearly present findings.
* Drive automation and perform ongoing validation/maintenance of new and existing loss mitigation reports; create automated reports with interactive data visualization intelligence.
* Proactively drive visual and content enhancements to loss mitigation program reporting for volumes and performance (e.g. advanced filters for due stage, channel, client, plan type, plan duration etc.).
* Support strategic initiatives by researching industry best practices, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to strengthen pre\-charge\-off loss mitigation efforts.
* Partner with multiple groups to implement reporting changes and assess post\-implementation execution and performance.
* Proactively communicate and engage across multiple levels, on the status of project progress and analytic priorities
* Lead loss mitigation strategy changes for required maintenance (e.g., NCI/NPI; MISC1 changes; regulatory updates). This includes obtaining Working Group and Tollgate approvals, strategy sheet updates, requests to Strategy Delivery, and tracking pre \& post implementation validations (if applicable).
* Support in transitioning all existing and future loss mitigation strategy test performance monitoring to the Growth team
* Provide Analytics support to build best in class strategies for Loss Mitigation programs
* Evaluate new data elements, sources, industry best practices for collections
* Co\-lead or support cross\-functional project teams to consistently track performance. Perform analytics to understand performance changes and make enhancements to address degradation.
* Support OCC, Audit, NMT accuracy requests, regulatory requirements for all loss mitigation programs and ensure strategy documentation is comprehensive, accurate and up to date (i.e., audit ready).
* Participate in ad\-hoc projects and analyses, as needed, Other duties as assigned.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.
* 4\+ years’ experience in SAS, SQL, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, organizational and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to make decisions and recommendations based on quantitative analysis and creative thinking
* Strong self\-starter balanced with desire to achieve team goals
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior Collection Strategy Development or Credit Strategy Development/ Risk Management experience and/or prior Collections experience in other functions
* 4\+ years demonstrated success developing and delivering advanced analytics solutions
* Data lake experience and strategies
* Master's degree in Business or in a Quantitative Related Field
* Proven analytical and decision\-making skills
* Experience developing scoring models or decision\-tree segmentations
* Ability to independently manage processes, Self\-motivated, and drive continuous process improvement

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description** 
 Nikkon Ferro Private Limited (NFPL) is a manufacturing and star export house specializing in copper\-plated grounding products, based in Kolkata, India since 1996\. Led by experienced engineers and a dynamic management team, NFPL produces UL\-standard ground rods and accessories that support safe and efficient earthing systems worldwide. Its products are used across telecommunications, broadcasting, power plants, substations, transportation networks, and large infrastructure projects. NFPL has a strong global presence in North America, Latin America, Europe, and the Indian Subcontinent, and holds multiple quality and compliance certifications including ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015\. The company is also affiliated with key industry bodies such as the Engineering Export Promotion Council (EEPC) and the Merchants Chamber of Commerce and Industry (MCCI).
 



**Role Description** 
 The Accountant role at NFPL is a full\-time, on\-site position based in the Greater Kolkata Area. The accountant will handle day\-to\-day accounting operations, including recording financial transactions, maintaining ledgers, and reconciling bank statements. Responsibilities include preparing invoices, monitoring accounts receivable and payable, supporting payroll processing, and assisting in monthly and annual financial closing. The role will involve generating financial reports, supporting audits, ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards and tax regulations, and coordinating with internal departments and external stakeholders. The accountant will also contribute to process improvements, maintain accurate documentation, and support management in budgeting and cost control activities.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong skills in financial accounting and bookkeeping, including ledger management and bank reconciliation.
* Proficiency in accounting software and MS Excel, with the ability to generate and analyze financial reports.
* Knowledge of tax regulations, compliance requirements, and statutory filings relevant to manufacturing and export operations.
* Attention to detail, accuracy in data entry, and strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Relevant academic background such as a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CA/CPA/Cost Accounting) are an advantage.
* Experience in manufacturing, export, or industrial sectors is preferred, especially familiarity with inventory and cost accounting.
* Ability to work on\-site in the Greater Kolkata Area and adapt to a fast\-paced, quality\-focused work environment.

**Invoicing**
* Maintain client codes in the firm’s proprietary accounting software based on information provided by the partner and/or manager .

* Maintain A/R notes against the bill record to describe any follow up activities performed
* Review the Electronic Funds Transfer database and post dated cheques log regularly, and action tickets as required
* Assisting in the preparation and presentation of financial reports to provide insights for decision\-making
* Engaging in financial budgeting and forecasting to optimize financial performance
* Supporting risk management initiatives by analyzing financial transactions and identifying potential issues
* Collaborating with team members to gather and analyze information from various sources
* Applying accounting and financial reporting standards to maintain accuracy in financial documentation
* Utilizing financial statement analysis to discern patterns and inform strategic guidance
* Participating in stakeholder management to address diverse perspectives and needs
* Contributing to the development of financial policies and procedures to enhance operational efficiency
* Adapting to a fast\-paced environment and taking ownership of tasks to deliver quality work
* Building a personal brand by consistently delivering value and opening doors to new opportunities


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a High School Diploma or the equivalent degree
* At least 1 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Preference for a Bachelor's degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Accounting \& Finance, Accounting \& Technology, Management Information Systems
